field-filter.sql:
-- one options query per picker
SELECT DISTINCT country FROM customers ORDER BY 1;

SELECT DISTINCT status FROM orders ORDER BY 1;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at) AS month,
  SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
-- built from the picks, minus any empty list
WHERE c.country IN ('Vietnam', 'Singapore')
  AND o.status IN ('completed')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

scope-vs-filter.sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at) AS month,
  SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
-- fixed rule: Reset must never remove it
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  -- from the reader's Country filter: Reset drops it
  AND c.country = 'Germany'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

compound-filter.sql:
SELECT c.country, p.category, o.status,
  SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
-- two groups from the builder, every value bound
WHERE (c.country = 'Vietnam' AND p.category = 'Software')
   OR (o.status = 'cancelled')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 4 DESC

aggregate-filter.sql:
SELECT c.name,
  SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
-- WHERE can't see a SUM. 12000 comes from the slider
HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) > 12000
ORDER BY revenue DESC

text-search.sql:
SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  -- 'customer 1' was typed. Escape any % and _ in it first
  AND c.name ILIKE '%customer 1%' ESCAPE '\'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY orders DESC

one-control-many.sql:
-- KPI and trend get the Country filter
SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE c.country = 'Japan';

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at) AS month,
  SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE c.country = 'Japan'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

-- the benchmark must not get it
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at) AS month,
  SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cascading-options.sql:
-- the product picker's options repeat the parent's WHERE
SELECT DISTINCT p.name
FROM products p
WHERE p.category IN ('Hardware')
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE p.category IN ('Hardware')
  -- picks Hardware no longer allows (Sprocket) removed first
  AND p.name IN ('Widget', 'Gizmo')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

apply-button.sql:
-- runs once on Apply, from the applied copy of the state,
-- not the pending one the reader is still editing
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at) AS month,
  SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE c.country = 'Japan'
  AND o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.ordered_at BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND DATE '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

selection-to-filter.sql:
SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
-- pinned chip, kept in the filter state
WHERE c.country = 'Vietnam'
  -- the new click, kept in the selection state
  AND p.category = 'Software'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

zoom-pan.sql:
-- before: month grain over every month
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at) AS period,
  SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

-- after the double-click: Sep 2026 by week
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', o.ordered_at) AS period,
  SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-09-01'
  AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

legend-toggle.sql:
-- hiding Services: no SQL. Alt-click on Parts: every
-- panel's query needs the same new WHERE
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at) AS month,
  p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE p.category = 'Parts'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE p.category = 'Parts'

single-select.sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at) AS month,
  SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
-- the app keeps the clicked list and rebuilds IN (...)
WHERE c.country IN ('Germany', 'Japan')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

-- heatmap cells: one bracket per picked pair
SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE (c.country = 'Vietnam'
    AND o.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2026-02-01')
   OR (c.country = 'Japan'
    AND o.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-03-01'
    AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2026-04-01')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

range-brush.sql:
-- brush pixels turned into dates, rounded to whole months
SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.ordered_at BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-01'
  AND DATE '2026-04-30';

SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.ordered_at BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-01'
  AND DATE '2026-04-30'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

numeric-brush.sql:
-- histogram: each order's value in $250 bins
SELECT FLOOR(v.order_value / 250) * 250 AS bin,
  COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM (
  SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS order_value
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY 1
) v
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE oi.order_id IN (
  SELECT oi2.order_id
  FROM order_items oi2
  JOIN products p2 ON p2.id = oi2.product_id
  GROUP BY 1
  -- order value again. 1000 and 2000 come from the brush
  HAVING SUM(oi2.quantity * p2.price) BETWEEN 1000 AND 2000
)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

cross-highlight.sql:
SELECT p.category,
  SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue,
  -- 'Vietnam' is the selected country
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'Vietnam'
    THEN oi.quantity * p.price END) AS highlight
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

two-selections.sql:
-- category chart: gets the country pick, not its own
SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE c.country = 'Germany'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

-- trend: both charts' picks, ANDed
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at) AS month,
  SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE c.country = 'Germany'
  AND p.category = 'Software'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

selection-cohort.sql:
-- the cohort: ids from the lasso
SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.customer_id IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

-- everyone else: the same query, the list again
SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.customer_id NOT IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

date-filter.sql:
-- exact dates: is 30 Jun included?
SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.ordered_at BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND DATE '2026-06-30';

-- "last 3 months": today in which time zone?
SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.ordered_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
    - INTERVAL '3 months'
  AND o.ordered_at < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE);

-- "last 30 days": a different shape again
SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.ordered_at > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'

custom-menu.sql:
-- Keep only
SELECT c.country, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE c.country = 'Germany'
GROUP BY 1;

-- Exclude: the app keeps the list of excluded values
SELECT c.country, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE c.country NOT IN ('Germany')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

-- Drill to customers: a second query, filtered the same way
SELECT c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,
  SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE c.country = 'Germany'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

range-filter.sql:
WITH ov AS (
  SELECT o.id, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS order_value
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN ov ON ov.id = o.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
-- two handles (one handle: ov.order_value > 2000)
WHERE ov.order_value BETWEEN 500 AND 2000
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
